group_norms.norm_text: We always cook for family events rather than catering — that's how Yemi raised us.
Birthdays get announced in the chat the day before; everyone reacts.
Reunion costs are split per household, not per adult.
Family weddings happen at home or in Lagos — not destination.
We don't air conflict in the main chat; take it to side messages.
